target: next 4-hour open-to-open BTCUSDT return; model fitted only on samples whose full target horizon is complete before retrain cutoff
entry: next 1h open after completed signal bar
overlap_policy: one position at a time; skip signals while a position is open
directions: LONG if predicted 4h return >= threshold; SHORT if predicted 4h return <= -threshold; otherwise NO_TRADE
feature_policy: all features use completed information at signal close; no current/future target information
retraining: monthly expanding walk-forward; initial training begins with available 2020-2023 history; every monthly model may use only samples with complete targets ending before that month
threshold_rationale: 21 bps = 1.5x 14bps stress round-trip cost; 38 bps approximates 1.5x 25bps severe round-trip cost rounded up
funding: actual funding strictly between entry and exit; positive benefit haircut 20% under stress/severe, negative funding cost magnified 20%

partitions.model_history: 2020-01-01..2024-12-31 for validation-era expanding fits subject to data availability

promotion_note: historical pass grants research/shadow eligibility only; never Demo order authority without new prospective evidence
